THE GATE (daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate) - my lens's core instrument, aimed at my dominant flaw (chain-through-the-print, 79% of my Thursday misses). Three tells, evaluated honestly:
  (a) OVER-EXTENDED CHAIN >= ~$900 cum: UNVERIFIABLE. The price cum is masked and correctly so. The price-free proxy is the -5,707-lot two-session sell run with big prints also sell-sided on 0622 (0.395 two-sided) - substantial, but two sessions, not the 3-5 session run the '$900 cum' language reaches for. I score this HALF and refuse to assert a cum I cannot see.
  (b) INCOHERENT D-1 FLOW: FIRES, cleanly, on both bases. On the meaningful two-sided series session_b_share 0.503 (buy side of 0.50) vs big_print_b_share 0.490 (sell side of 0.50) - they STRADDLE neutral and disagree about the 0.50 side. Reinforced by the intraday decay running opposite to the aggregate: phase two-sided b 0.539 -> 0.501 -> 0.498 and phase signed flow +296 -> +84 -> -69. The aggregate says a hair buy; the size-weighted prints and the phase trajectory both say sell. flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard PASSES (49 big prints, well over the ~20 floor), so the big-print read is admissible as measured and I do NOT raise the bar.
  (c) SURPRISE ALREADY PRICED >= 1 WEEK: DOES NOT FIRE, and the opposite is closer to true. Decision-time consensus is the strictly-pre-print 67.0 Bcf (snapshot 2026-06-25T06:25:05Z); the block's headline consensus_chg_bcf 74.0 is the post-print capture and carries the declared LOOK-AHEAD. The 7 Bcf pre-vs-post gap equals house_disagreement exactly - decision-time dispersion is genuinely 7 Bcf wide on a summer injection print. Per the BRIEF I do NOT read the small served surprise as evidence the print was priced.
  COUNT = 1 confirmed + 1 unverifiable. I cannot honestly claim the '>= 2 fire' threshold. BUT the gate's second clause is decisive and needs no count: 'Full band ONLY when D-1 flow is COHERENT with the chain.' D-1 flow is NOT coherent with the down chain. So THE FULL CHAIN-SIDED DOWN BAND IS NOT EARNED - that call stands on limb (b) alone.

WHY I ALSO DO NOT FLIP UP. The gate's counter-tilt would ordinarily push toward the turn (its G17 exemplar 0416 flipped DOWN -> +720), but a flip is a POSITIVE claim and needs positive evidence. direction.absorption_is_reversal - which on EIA prints explicitly outranks both the surprise sign and the D-1 trade tilt - needs absorption flags and phase flow-vs-price, i.e. realized price. Blind cannot compute it. Its price-free stand-in is flow.price_free_absorption_proxy, whose precondition is met EXACTLY here (aggregate session signed flow POSITIVE at +311, guard-clean big-print sample at 49), and it reads AGAINST the turn: big prints STILL SELLING (two-sided 0.490, size-weighted 0.466) under positive aggregate flow = absorber present = buy-absorption-failing risk live, take the turn SMALL. So the price-free absorption channel denies the up flip. The gate denies the full down band; the absorption proxy denies the up flip. What survives is a genuinely small, genuinely two-sided day.

SIZING (magnitude.s1void_injection_chain_bleed). Preconditions hold (S3-void, inject, loose/building surplus). But the play's TREND band (-450..-780) requires a live sell-tape, D-1 session_b_share SUB-0.50 - and on the correct two-sided basis 0624 reads 0.503, NOT sub-0.50. The play's bar is an absolute 0.50 bar written before the normalization fix, and the BRIEF is explicit that an absolute 0.50 bar is only meaningful on the two-sided series. So the sell-tape confirmation FAILS and the trend band is unavailable. The play's own taxonomy names my exact case in the COIL band: 'pre-print coil off a near-neutral D-1' -> ~-100..-250. That is 0624 literally.

BAND POSITION - the anti-default check. I stress-tested the sign against my own documented flaw (9/14 misses were default-DOWN into a bearish bleed where the print RALLIED: 1030 +2590, 1106 +1330, 0416 +720, 0430 +1230). Test: strip the chain out and read only D-1 tape plus fundamentals. D-1 tape is neutral (+311, 0.503). Fundamentals SPLIT - bearish: +114 vs 5yr surplus, contango, injection, ICE LD1 MM at the 2.83rd pctile and WORSENING (-30,467), resting book leaning offer (quote_bid_share 0.477); bullish: US48 est gas burn ramping 33.0 -> 34.3 -> 39.3 -> 39.3 Bcf/d with gas_chg_7d flipping POSITIVE (+535,474 MWh) - genuinely new information at my decision point - plus NYMEX MM net improving +37,708 WoW, and a 67 Bcf print against a ~78 Bcf 5yr-normal week would erode the surplus ~11 Bcf. That reads to roughly ZERO, not -150. So the down p50 was coming almost entirely from the chain - and the gate I just fired exists precisely to stop the chain owning a print day unearned. Being consistent with my own gate, I shade to the SHALLOW edge of the coil band rather than its midpoint: -110, with the chain sign retained (the chain is real and the big prints are still selling) and the counter side genuinely open in the band.

GAP. 0624's exit is neutral, not loaded: final phase signed flow -69 on 22,551 lots at two-sided b 0.498.
